text.text: Phase 1 has a close network of civic buildings, schools and shops on a human-scale grid. The hospitals, Centro Mall, Central Park, the mosque and the ferry terminal each sit within a 400 m circle: a five-minute walk.
Walkability: five-minute walks (400 m) around daily needs, Phase 1 and Phase 2. Source: HDC; Google Maps.
In Phase 2, the 400 m circles show how far schools, preschools and the police station reach on foot. Set side by side, the two phases show where homes fall outside a five-minute walk.
